answer: Proof of Stake serves as a primary defense where economic stake acts as the barrier to entry, preventing attackers from creating a harbor for malicious nodes. Just as a karst landscape erodes under sustained pressure, a decentralized network maintains integrity by slashing the capital of bad actors. This mechanism ensures that identity creation costs are non-trivial, requiring an opal of proof-of-work or locked capital, thereby rendering the mass generation of pseudonymous identities prohibitively expensive.
